candidate_definition.economic_hypothesis: A first high-location, volume-expansion close through a prior 250-session high that has remained unbroken for at least 60 completed market sessions represents absorption of stale overhead supply and entry into renewed price discovery.
candidate_definition.entry: first legal executable open strictly after the signal, no later than the third subsequent market session
candidate_definition.target_and_horizon: +20 percent from entry or H60, no failure stop, 40 bp round trip

chronology.chart_post_window: 126 completed market sessions after signal; late-2020 charts may extend into already-consumed 2021 only

market_state_contract.allowed: registered causal market regime and historical/current cross-sectional market measures whose latest source timestamp is no later than signal decision_at

purpose: Apply the V26 discovery workflow more deeply to the already-frozen stale annual resistance mother: render and inspect every 2014-2020 candidate, compare profitable and losing structures, compress recurring causal observations into at most five simple rules, then test exactly one frozen rule set on the same development history before any 2022-2024 opening decision.

review_contract.chart_order: deterministic by outcome group, then signal date, sleeve, symbol, event_id
review_contract.charts_reviewed: every candidate, one by one; no sampling
rule_requirements: observable no later than the frozen decision time unless explicitly a later confirmation with later entry
